rationale: All four lenses and the standards audit ran with parseable output; 31 of 32 story/spec criteria pass and EPMCDME-15445 AC4's live PostgreSQL 14 check is pending-stage-7. Of 18 candidates checked against source, 1 was deferred (a child row inserted after the batch snapshot is orphaned until the orphan purge, the same exposure as the replaced _session_purge; see code-review-deferred.md) and 17 dismissed as handled or noise: the $4 skip list keeps held/heavy ids from repeating, torn sessions keeping session_dims is the accepted deviation 3, every _purge_group statement is a plain DELETE, and the missing live SQL test is AC4's Stage 7 check.

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445: purge deletes in bounded batches, each batch in its own transaction
business_review.notes: _purge_batches: one batch_statement per conn.transaction(), LIMIT $2 and row cap $3

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445 (deviation 2): batches go on until one finds no idle session; an all-held batch does not stop the run
business_review.notes: loop breaks on no candidates; batches with new held/heavy ids continue

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445: batches are not ordered by age
business_review.notes: batch CTE has no ORDER BY

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445: a session is deleted whole or not at all (deviations 1 and 3)
business_review.notes: one WITH statement per batch excluding held/torn; heavy sessions in parts, session_dims last

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445: a session made non-idle during the purge keeps all its rows
business_review.notes: MATERIALIZED FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED batch; part_statement re-tests idle each part

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445: client times after today are not believed
business_review.notes: _idle reuses PartitionMaintainer._past against tomorrow

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445: no now(), injected clock (deviation 4: one clock_timestamp() for the idle-left count)
business_review.notes: cutoff bound as $1; sole DB clock read feeds idle_left_statement $2

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445 AC1: more idle sessions than one batch are all deleted in one run in several batches
business_review.notes: test_sessions_are_purged_in_batches_until_one_finds_no_candidate

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445 AC2: a timeout in batch N leaves batches 1..N-1 committed; next run continues
business_review.notes: per-batch transactions; _ISOLATED_FAILURES reported as 'purge sessions'

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445 AC3: existing purge behaviour unchanged
business_review.notes: _orphan_purge unchanged and still run after the session purge

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445 AC4: a unit test covers the loop with a table larger than one batch
business_review.notes: test_session_purge.py batch-loop tests via RecordingConnection

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445 AC4: a live check passes on PostgreSQL 14
business_review.notes: no code missing; execution against PostgreSQL 14 is Stage 7's proof

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445 AC5: the storage guide (Retention) describes the batching
business_review.notes: cli-analytics-storage.md Retention row and batch-size setting row updated

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445 deviation 1: a session above 100 000 child rows is deleted in parts, session_dims last
business_review.notes: heavy CTE -> _purge_in_parts with shared $3 budget

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445 deviation 3: a session with a child row changed mid-statement keeps session_dims and is reported
business_review.notes: torn CTE compares counted vs deleted rows; torn ids returned with held

business_review.item: EPMCDME-15445 deviation 5: a first batch too heavy for the timeout repeats; lowering the batch size resolves it
business_review.notes: documented in the guide's Alert on and Retention rows

business_review.item: EPMCDME-16143 AC1: with one idle session's rows held, one run deletes all other idle sessions
business_review.notes: child rows locked SKIP LOCKED; held session added to $4 skip list

business_review.item: EPMCDME-16143 AC2: the held session is kept whole and deleted by the first run after release
business_review.notes: held CTE excluded from every delete; skip list is per run

business_review.item: EPMCDME-16143 AC3: ERROR names held child-row and held session_dims sessions, up to 10 ids
business_review.notes: finally-block ERROR with held[:10]; _count_idle_left adds held dims rows

business_review.item: EPMCDME-16143 AC4: purge without a held session works as before
business_review.notes: same _idle predicate; test_a_purge_with_no_held_session_logs_no_skipped_sessions

business_review.item: MR: purge in session_purge.py, called by PartitionMaintainer from the same place; orphan purge after it
business_review.notes: _purge_expired_rows calls purge_idle_sessions then 'session orphans'

business_review.notes: Alert on and Retention rows updated

standards_review.notes: all 13 subjects in 97b1b5f8d..HEAD, merge commits included, follow the git-workflow.md 'EPMCDME-####: Description' format with a ticket prefix, colon and capitalized description
new modules carry the Apache 2.0 header; typed signatures, X | None unions; purge extracted into its own module (Module Cohesion); maintenance.py stays at 457 lines, under ~500
no auth/secret/external-input handling; f-string SQL interpolates only module constants and int()-cast policy fragments; runtime values are asyncpg bind parameters; logs carry no credentials
